strings: AgentsVoice
Enable the Voice Mode panel in the chat view for voice-driven coding conversations.
BrowserChatTools
When enabled, chat agents can use browser tools to open and interact with pages in the Integrated Browser.
ChatAgentAllowedNetworkDomains

Allowed domains for network access by agent tools (fetch tool, integrated browser) when `#chat.agent.networkFilter#` is enabled. In Copilot Agent Host sessions with sandboxing (`#chat.agent.sandbox.enabled#`) enabled, also restricts the integrated browser when outbound network access (`#chat.agent.sandbox.network.allowNetwork#`) is allowed; an empty allow list adds no sandbox restriction. This list does not enable outbound access. Supports wildcards like `*.example.com`. Outside sandboxing, when both allowed and denied lists are empty, all domains are blocked. Denied domains (see `#chat.agent.sandbox.network.deniedDomains#`) take precedence.

Changes may not take full effect until VS Code is restarted.
ChatAgentDeniedNetworkDomains

Denied domains for network access by agent tools (fetch tool, integrated browser) when `#chat.agent.networkFilter#` is enabled. Also applies to the integrated browser in sandboxed Copilot Agent Host sessions (`#chat.agent.sandbox.enabled#`); allowing outbound network access (`#chat.agent.sandbox.network.allowNetwork#`) does not bypass this list. Takes precedence over `#chat.agent.sandbox.network.allowedDomains#`. Supports wildcards like `*.example.com`.

Changes may not take full effect until VS Code is restarted.
ChatAgentExtensionTools
Enable using tools contributed by third-party extensions.
ChatAgentHostCustomTerminalTool
Enable the Agent Host custom terminal tool override for Copilot SDK sessions.
ChatAgentMode
When enabled, agent mode can be activated from chat and tools in agentic contexts with side effects can be used.
ChatAgentNetworkFilter

When enabled, network access by agent tools (fetch tool, integrated browser) is restricted according to `#chat.agent.sandbox.network.allowedDomains#` and `#chat.agent.sandbox.network.deniedDomains#`. Domain filtering is also applied to those tools when `#chat.agent.sandbox.enabled#` is enabled.

Changes may not take full effect until VS Code is restarted.
ChatAllowedMcpServers
Allowlist of Model Context Protocol servers. When set, only servers matching an entry may be installed or run; omit entirely to allow all servers (subject to the deny list).
ChatAllowManagedHooksOnly
Allows hooks only from enterprise-managed sources and plugins force-enabled by policy.
ChatAllowManagedMcpServersOnly
Use only the enterprise-managed MCP allowlist when deciding which servers may run.
ChatApprovedAccountOrganizations

Setting this policy to a non-empty list activates the Approved Account gate: all AI features are disabled until the user signs into a GitHub account whose organizations intersect this list AND the account-side policy data has resolved. Comparison is case-insensitive. Use '*' as a wildcard to accept any signed-in GitHub or GHE account (use this for GHE deployments where the organization list is not surfaced).
ChatDefaultModel
Sets the default chat model for new conversations. Accepts "auto", a model family name (such as "opus" or "gemini"), or a full model id. Users can still switch the model within a conversation.
ChatDeniedMcpServers
Denylist of Model Context Protocol servers. Servers matching any entry are blocked from being installed or run, even if they also match the allow list; deny rules always take precedence.
ChatEditorPreferCopilotHarness
Configure whether VS Code uses the Agent Host Copilot SDK instead of the local harness for new editor chat sessions.
ChatEnabledPlugins
Plugin enablement. Keys are plugin IDs in `{plugin}@{marketplace}` form; values enable or disable the plugin.
ChatExtraMarketplaces

Additional plugin marketplaces to query. Keys are marketplace names; values are GitHub shorthand (`owner/repo[#ref]`) or Git URIs (`{url}[#ref]`), optionally with an enterprise-managed auto-update override.
ChatHooks

Controls whether chat hooks are executed at strategic points during an agent's workflow. Hooks are loaded from the files configured in `#chat.hookFilesLocations#`. This setting is only used by the Local agent harness.
ChatMCP
Controls access to installed Model Context Protocol servers.
No access to MCP servers.
Allows access to MCP servers listed in the registry that VS Code is connected to.
Allow access to any installed MCP server.
ChatPluginsEnabled
Enable agent plugin integration in chat.
ChatStrictMarketplaces
Allowlist of plugin marketplace sources. When set, only marketplaces matching an entry are trusted; an empty array blocks all marketplaces.
ChatStrictPluginOnlyCustomization
Blocks standalone user and workspace skills, agents, hooks, instructions, and MCP servers while keeping eligible plugin customizations available.
ChatToolsAutoApprove

Global auto approve also known as "YOLO mode" disables manual approval completely for all tools in all workspaces, allowing the agent to act fully autonomously. This is extremely dangerous and is *never* recommended, even containerized environments like Codespaces and Dev Containers have user keys forwarded into the container that could be compromised.

This feature disables critical security protections and makes it much easier for an attacker to compromise the machine.

Note: This setting only controls tool approval and does not prevent the agent from asking questions. To automatically answer agent questions, use the `#chat.autoReply#` setting.
ChatToolsEligibleForAutoApproval

Controls which tools are eligible for automatic approval. Tools set to 'false' will always present a confirmation and will never offer the option to auto-approve. The default behavior (or setting a tool to 'true') may result in the tool offering auto-approval options.
Claude3PIntegration
Enable Claude Agent sessions in VS Code. Start and resume agentic coding sessions powered by Anthropic Claude Agent SDK directly in the editor. Uses your existing Copilot subscription.
Codex3PIntegration
Enable Codex Agent sessions in VS Code. Start and resume agentic coding sessions powered by OpenAI Codex. Usage can be routed through GitHub Copilot or authenticated directly with an OpenAI account.
CopilotNextEditSuggestions
Whether to enable next edit suggestions (NES). NES can propose a next edit based on your recent changes.
CopilotOtelCaptureContent
Controls whether Copilot OpenTelemetry export captures prompt, response, and tool content.
CopilotOtelCaptureIdentity
Controls whether Copilot OpenTelemetry captures the authenticated account name, operating system username, and machine hostname. Independent of content capture.
CopilotOtelEnabled
Controls whether Copilot OpenTelemetry export is enabled. When managed, users cannot override the enterprise value.
CopilotOtelEndpoint
Controls the enterprise-managed OTLP collector endpoint for Copilot OpenTelemetry export.
CopilotOtelHeaders
Controls the enterprise-managed OTLP exporter headers for Copilot OpenTelemetry export.
CopilotOtelOtlpProtocol
Controls the enterprise-managed OTLP wire protocol (protobuf vs JSON) for Copilot OpenTelemetry export.
CopilotOtelOutfile
Prevents local file export when enterprise-managed Copilot OpenTelemetry export is configured.
CopilotOtelProtocol
Controls the enterprise-managed OTLP protocol for Copilot OpenTelemetry export.
Use OTLP over HTTP.
Use OTLP over gRPC.
Console exporter is not selected by enterprise managed settings.
File exporter is not selected by enterprise managed settings.
CopilotOtelResourceAttributes
Controls the enterprise-managed OTel resource attributes for Copilot OpenTelemetry export.
CopilotOtelServiceName
Controls the enterprise-managed OTel `service.name` resource attribute for Copilot OpenTelemetry export.
CopilotReviewAgent
Enables the code review agent.
CopilotReviewSelection
Enables code review on current selection.
CopilotSessionSync
Enable session sync to GitHub.com for cross-device Copilot session history. When disabled by organization policy, session data is kept local only.
DictationEnabled
Controls whether dictation is available across the product (chat input, editor, and terminal).
DictationLLMCleanup
Controls whether final dictation transcripts are sent to a language model for cleanup.
DictationModel
Controls the transcription model used for dictation.
Use the on-device transcription model. Audio does not leave the device.
Use the cloud transcription service. Audio is streamed to the service.
McpEnterpriseManagedAuthIdp
The OAuth/OIDC IdP configuration used for enterprise-managed Model Context Protocol (MCP) server authentication.
McpGalleryServiceUrl
Configure the MCP Gallery service URL to connect to
AllowedExtensions

Specify a list of extensions that are allowed to use. This helps maintain a secure and consistent development environment by restricting the use of unauthorized extensions. More information: https://aka.ms/vscode/enterprise/extensions/allowed
ExtensionGalleryAuthProvider
Configure the authentication provider for the Extensions Marketplace
Authenticate to the Extensions Marketplace using GitHub.
Authenticate to the Extensions Marketplace using a Microsoft (Entra ID) account.
ExtensionGalleryServiceUrl
Configure the Marketplace service URL to connect to
ExtensionsAutoUpdate
Controls the automatic update behavior of extensions. The updates are fetched from a Microsoft online service.
Download and install updates automatically only for enabled extensions.
Extensions are not automatically updated.
ExtensionsAutoUpdateDelay

Controls the delay in hours after an extension update is published before it is automatically installed. Only applies when `#extensions.autoUpdate#` is set to `on`. This delay helps avoid installing potentially problematic updates immediately after release.
ChatAgentSandboxAllowNetwork

Deprecated. Controls whether the Local agent sandbox allows outbound connections to all network domains while preserving file system restrictions. Use the sandbox.userPolicy.network.allowOutbound managed setting to enforce outbound network restrictions in Copilot Agent Host.
ChatAgentSandboxAllowUnsandboxedCommands

Deprecated. Controls whether Local agent terminal commands can run outside the sandbox after user confirmation when sandbox restrictions would block the command. Use the sandbox.allowBypass managed setting to control sandbox bypass in Copilot Agent Host.
ChatAgentSandboxEnabled

Deprecated. Controls whether the Local agent uses sandboxing to restrict what tools can do. In Copilot Agent Host, this legacy policy supplies an overridable sandbox default, not a mandatory requirement. Use the runtime-native sandbox.enabled managed setting to require sandboxing in Copilot Agent Host.
Disable sandboxing for agent mode tools.
Enable sandboxing for agent mode tools.
ChatToolsTerminalEnableAutoApprove
Controls whether to allow auto approval in the run in terminal tool.
EnableFeedback
Enable feedback mechanisms such as the issue reporter, surveys, and other feedback options.
TelemetryLevel
Controls the level of telemetry.
Sends usage data, errors, and crash reports.
Sends general error telemetry and crash reports.
Sends OS level crash reports.
Disables all product telemetry.
UpdateMode
Configure whether you receive automatic updates. The updates are fetched from a Microsoft online service.
Disable updates.
Disable automatic background update checks. Updates will be available if you manually check for updates.
Check for updates only on startup. Disable automatic background update checks.
Enable automatic update checks. Code will check for updates automatically and periodically.
